Kestrel Customer Service Policy (March 2026)

1. Delivery windows

Standard deliveries are promised within a 2-hour window. Express deliveries are promised within a
30-minute window and cost a surcharge of EUR 4.90.

2. Refunds

If a delivery arrives more than 20 minutes after the end of its window, the customer receives a
refund of 50 % of the delivery fee. If the payload is lost (incident code KX-2), the customer receives
a full refund plus a EUR 15 voucher. Refunds are issued automatically within 5 business days.

3. Customer contact after incidents

3. Customer contact after incidents

After a KX-2 incident, customer service contacts the customer within 4 hours. After a KX-3 incident,
only the managing director's office contacts the customer.

4. Restricted items

We do not carry lithium batteries above 100 Wh, liquids above 1 litre, living animals, or anything
classified as dangerous goods. Medication is accepted only from registered pharmacies.

5. Photos and data

Proof-of-delivery photos are kept for 30 days and then deleted. Flight logs are kept for 2 years.

Incident Review Q3 2026

Prepared by the operations team. Three incidents in the quarter, no injuries.

Incident 1 - 14 July 2026, Mannheim (KX-1)

A K-4 Kestrel was grounded mid-route after a lightning strike 9 km away; the 15/30 rule was applied
and the drone waited at a safe landing point. The parcel arrived 41 minutes after the end of its
Standard window, so the late-delivery refund applied.

Incident 2 - 2 August 2026, Rhine crossing near Ludwigshafen
(KX-2)

A K-7 Heron released its payload early over the river bank. Root cause: a timing bug in latch
firmware 3.1.4. The payload was recovered, but damaged. The fleet was updated to latch firmware
3.1.6 within 48 hours; no repeat since.

A K-7 Heron released its payload early over the river bank. Root cause: a timing bug in latch
firmware 3.1.4. The payload was recovered, but damaged. The fleet was updated to latch firmware
3.1.6 within 48 hours; no repeat since.

Incident 3 - 3 September 2026, Heidelberg (near miss)

A K-2 Sparrow came within 20 m of a newly erected construction crane that was missing from the
map. New rule: construction-zone geofences are refreshed every Monday from the city's permit
feed.

This handbook is binding for all flight operations staff. It replaces version 4.1 from November 2025.

Kestrel operates three drone models. Payload limits drop in rain because wet propellers lose lift; the

2. Weather rules

2. Weather rules

No flight may start when the forecast wind at flight altitude exceeds the model's maximum wind
rating. Lightning: if a strike is detected within 15 km of the route, all drones on that route are
grounded until 30 minutes after the last strike (the 15/30 rule). Below -10 degrees Celsius batteries
must be pre-warmed to at least 15 degrees before launch.

3. Night operations

Night flights (sunset to sunrise) require form NW-17, signed by the shift lead before the first launch
of the night. The maximum altitude at night is 90 m above ground; during the day it is 120 m.

4. Battery policy

4. Battery policy

A battery whose state of health falls below 82 % is retired and sent to recycling. Batteries in storage
are kept at a 55 % charge. Every battery carries a QR label with its cycle count.
